 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The grid's diagonal strokes encode a repeating sequence across columns.
    # Determine the primitive sequence from colors on the marked diagonal.
    residues={}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]: residues[(c-r)%w]=grid[r][c]
    # Sort residues; preserve repeated colors in the sequence (they matter).
    inds=sorted(residues)
    seq=[residues[i] for i in inds]
    if not seq: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # These traces are periodic with the number of distinct sequential colors.
    n=len(seq)
    return [[seq[(c-r)%n] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
",
 "path": "programs/task-0453eddf.py"
}

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Marked parallel diagonal rays encode a cyclic sequence. Recover the
    # sequence in the direction perpendicular to the rays (column-row).
    byres={}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]: byres[(c-r)%w]=grid[r][c]
    # Use cyclic order of observed residues, then repeat the shortest observed
    # sequence; sparse colored endpoints belong to the template too.
    indices=sorted(byres)
    seq=[byres[i] for i in indices]
    if not seq: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Collapse repeated neighboring colors only if they are consecutive traces.
    p=len(seq)
    return [[seq[(c-r)%p] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
",

}

    # marked color sequence while filling blank diagonal residues periodically.

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]: residues[(c-r)%w]=grid[r][c]
    # Sorted residues in this case form the repeated source motif.
    ordered=[residues[k] for k in sorted(residues)]
    if not ordered: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Source motif has one item per marked diagonal residue; cycle it to width.
    return [[ordered[(c-r)%len(ordered)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Extract the diagonal color motif by tracking the marked rays in order
    # along their common direction. The motif repeats across every row.
    cells=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
    # Group ray colors by diagonal offset c-r and order offsets descending.
    ray={}
    for r,c,v in cells: ray[c-r]=v
    motif=[]
    for k in sorted(ray,reverse=True):
        v=ray[k]
        if not motif or motif[-1]!=v: motif.append(v)
    # Anchoring at input's top-left ray follows the input diagonal sequence.
    return [[motif[(r+c)%len(motif)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
",
 "path": "programs/task-0453eddf.py"
}
